nilReasons.documentation: A divisor equal to zero, or indistinguishable from zero within the comparison budget.
A well-formed operand outside the operation's domain — the canonical case is SQRT of a negative rational.
A well-formed index or count outside the addressed collection's bounds, answered as a projection rather than a raise.
Text that does not denote a value in the operation's target encoding — NUM applied to text outside the sealed numeric grammar, or STR applied to a value with no exact lexeme.
A NIL the program wrote rather than computed: the NIL Word, or NIL inside a vector literal. Not produced by any Word's projection.
A diagnostic or structural accessor found no field to report at the position it was asked about.
A diagnostic accessor was asked for something the value does not carry — NIL-REASON applied to a value that carries no reason.

A well-formed generative operation (RANGE, FILL) whose materialized result would exceed the space water level. The only reason that projects rather than raises even for a request that could never fit.
Comparison-budget exhaustion: two lazy continued-fraction streams agreed on every emitted partial quotient up to the budget without resolving the order of the two operands.

errorCategories.documentation: A higher-order Word's block operand did not return the shape its contract requires — MAP/FILTER/FOLD/ANY's block returned other than one value per contract.
An operation tried to redefine or delete a Core Word.
COND: every guard failed and no else clause was given.
DEF named a word the dictionary already binds in a way this definition cannot resolve.
The total execution-step budget was exhausted before the program finished.
A well-formed index or count outside the addressed collection's bounds, raised rather than projected — TAKE asking for more elements than the vector holds.
COND received a clause that is not a [ guard block ] or [ else-block ] pair.
A count operand is malformed for its Word's contract — TAKE or COLLECT given a count that cannot be honored structurally (distinct from negativeCount and from the indexOutOfBounds projection).
DEF was given a body that is not a well-formed definition: not a Vector, or a Vector with no statements.
GET received an index operand that is not itself a well-formed index (non-integer, wrong shape) — distinct from indexOutOfBounds, which is a well-formed index outside bounds.
DEF or DEL was given a name that cannot be a Word name at all (empty, wrong lexical shape).
RANGE's bounds do not describe a well-formed range (e.g. a non-finite span).
FILL's shape operand is not a well-formed shape vector.
Program text that does not parse — an unclosed block, a | outside a clause, a mismatched delimiter.
OR-NIL's top was NIL and no source unit follows it to evaluate as the fallback.
DEF was asked to define a name a live binding already holds — a name was asked to mean two things at once.
BIND was asked to bind a name that is already a Word name.
RANDOM (or another count-taking Word) received a negative count.
SORT or ORDER met an element its comparison law cannot order.
An operand that must be a whole number carried a non-integer scalar — RANDOM's bound, PUT's index.
An arithmetic Word (ADD/SUB/MUL/DIV) met an operand that is not a number.
A text-only Word (CHARS/TRIM/TOKENIZE/NUM), or a name operand (DEF/DEL/BIND), met an operand that is not Text.
JOIN met a vector element that cannot serve as text content — not Text, and not a number that decodes to a character code.
TOKENIZE's separator operand is not Text.
JOIN's operand is not a Vector at all (the top-level shape check, despite the name — distinct from nonTextElement's per-element check).
COND met a guard clause that did not answer with a truth value.
AND, OR, NOT, or a FILTER/ANY/ALL predicate block, met a value that is not a truth value or Unknown.
A collection Word (GET/LENGTH/TAKE/CONCAT) met an operand that is not a Vector.
A higher-order Word's block operand is not a CodeBlock.
DEF or DEL targeted a Core Word name, which the dictionary protects.
The native call-depth guard fired: a pathologically long acyclic call chain reached its nesting limit.
A named internal-computation ceiling other than the step budget was crossed — bigintBits, algebraicTerms, a numeric literal's digit count, or a program's byte length.
DEF was refused because the body names itself, directly or through other User words — the DEF-time acyclicity check.
Two operands of an element-wise Word have shapes that do not broadcast on some axis.
A Word was applied with fewer operands than its declared arity.
A value's structure did not match what the operation expected, outside the more specific shape/vector-length categories.
A name in program text did not resolve to any Word in the compiled-in vocabulary or the live dictionary.
EQ/NEQ/LT/LTE met a pair of operands whose types have no defined comparison law.
Two one-dimensional operands have different lengths where the operation requires them equal — the one-dimensional case of shapeMismatch.
DEL (or another dictionary Word) was asked to act on a name that names no Word.
